stem: In which way did the trend represented in this graph result in economic growth during this time period?

options.label: A
options.text: People paid higher interest rates on bank loans.

options.label: B
options.text: People had more money to spend on consumer goods.

options.label: C
options.text: The government reduced its deficit spending.

options.label: D
options.text: The government reduced regulations on stock market investments.

visual_elements: Line graph titled 'U.S. Income Tax Rates for the Highest Bracket, 1918-1928' with tax rates on the y-axis from 0 to 90 percent and years on the x-axis from 1918 to 1928, showing a downward trend in tax rates from about 77% in 1918 to 25% in 1928.
